verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item addresses AI training data opt-out or privacy controls specific to AI model training; evidence covers developer APIs, Nitro features, and unrelated community complaints. This is an applicable axis for a consumer platform handling user data/messages, but nothing in the pack shows Discord offering such a control, so it defaults to none. missing for 10: any documentation of an AI-training opt-out setting, privacy policy language on AI model training use of user content, or community confirmation of such a control.
